lines.say: The government's Intel stake lost over eleven billion dollars in one day.

lines.text: Intel shares fell about 29% on Friday, their worst day since 1974, CNBC and Yahoo Finance report.
lines.say: Intel shares fell about twenty-nine percent on Friday, their worst day since nineteen seventy-four, CNBC and Yahoo Finance report.

lines.text: Intel said next quarter's sales could be $15 to $16 billion, below the roughly $17 billion analysts expected.
lines.say: Intel said next quarter's sales could be fifteen to sixteen billion dollars, below the roughly seventeen billion analysts expected.

lines.text: So why does Washington care? In August 2025, it took about 10% of Intel at $20.47 a share.
lines.say: So why does Washington care? In August twenty twenty-five, it took about ten percent of Intel at about twenty dollars a share.

lines.text: Thursday the stock closed at $92.07. Friday, $65.76.
lines.say: Thursday the stock closed near ninety-two dollars. Friday, near sixty-six.

lines.text: By our math, 433.3 million shares times a $26.31 drop is about $11.4 billion, on paper.
lines.say: By our math, about four hundred thirty-three million shares times a twenty-six dollar drop is about eleven point four billion dollars, on paper.

lines.text: But the stake is still worth about $28.5 billion, more than 3 times the $8.9 billion it cost.
lines.say: But the stake is still worth about twenty-eight and a half billion dollars, more than three times the eight point nine billion it cost.

lines.text: The takeaway: one stock fell 29% in a day. The S&P 500, holding 500 companies, fell 1.8%.

post.title: Uncle Sam's Intel stake lost $11B+ in one day
post.ig:
The government's Intel stake lost over $11 billion in one day.
Intel fell about 29% on Friday, Oct 30, its worst day since 1974, after guiding next-quarter sales to $15B-$16B vs about $17B expected.
The US took about 10% of Intel (433.3M shares at $20.47) in August 2025. By our math, Friday's drop cut that stake by about $11.4B on paper; it is still worth about $28.5B, over 3x its $8.9B cost.
Same day, the S&P 500 fell 1.8%.
Sources: CNBC, Yahoo Finance, AP (Oct 30, 2026); Intel Q3 2026 release (Oct 29, 2026).
